changelog: **Dark mode:** the accent layer (`html[data-accent] .bg|text|border|ring-blue-*`, always on) no longer overrides an element's own `dark:` colour. The remap outranked Tailwind's `dark:` variant (0,2,1 vs 0,2,0), so the active "My records" toggle on the lead list kept its light fill under light text (1.16:1), and `text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300` links stayed dark blue on dark pages. Each remap now carries a zero-specificity `:not(:where(.dark [class*="dark:<prop>-"]))` guard, and `check:dark-mode` fails on a remap without it (#3745).

en: In dark mode, active filter buttons and blue links are readable again: their text no longer disappears into a light background.
tr: Dark mode'da aktif filtre butonları ve mavi bağlantılar yeniden okunuyor: yazıları artık açık renkli zeminde kaybolmuyor.
de: Im dunklen Modus sind aktive Filterschaltflächen und blaue Links wieder lesbar: ihr Text verschwindet nicht mehr auf hellem Hintergrund.
